items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: Yeah, Lizzie Miles. That's right. Well, she knew my brother well, too.

ctx.x: It's the colored woman that used to sing all these— Oh, Miles.
Yeah, Lizzie Miles. That's right. Well, she knew my brother well, too. Oh, yes.
She would have known him very well. She made records with him. Mm-hmm. She knew him very well. It's on the Victor Record, one of them, where she sang— Yes, I'm sure, yeah. Yes, I knew her quite well.
